game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round, yeti raiders strike the hearth fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the wires value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from yeti raiders in Snow Fort: keep the wires meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: wires drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while wires > 0.
